summary: Momentus Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $75 million of its Class A common stock under a shelf registration. The company entered into a Sales Agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners as sales agent, who will receive a 3% commission on gross proceeds. Sales will be made through ordinary broker transactions on Nasdaq or at negotiated prices, with no escrow arrangement. The filing is a routine takedown from an existing shelf; no special-situation category applies. The ATM offers the company flexible capital access but may dilute existing shareholders.
